role.instructions: state describes one JavaScript file or inline script on a WordPress page of type state.page_type: its handle or id, source URL, size and the first part of its code. Decide when the page needs it.

criteria.render_critical: Needed to paint the first screen correctly: layout, above-the-fold slider, header menu structure, or content that is built by script.
criteria.early_interaction: Needed soon after load for interaction: menu toggle, forms, popups triggered by the visitor, cookie consent, or lazy-load of images.
criteria.delay_safe: Can wait until the visitor interacts: analytics, tag managers, ads, pixels, chat widgets, social embeds, or below-the-fold features.
